Journal.Title: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism

Article.ArticleTitle: PDE5 Inhibition Ameliorates Visceral Adiposity Targeting the miR-22/SIRT1 Pathway: Evidence From the CECSID Trial.

Abstract.AbstractText: This trial provides in-vivo and in-vitro evidence that chronic inhibition of PDE5 in type 2 diabetes regulates miR22 release, SIRT1 expression and epicardial fat, thus improving cardiovascular risk.
